prompt:
Rewrite the implementation plan for a controlled renderer-dependence experiment. Hold the surface task and all non-policy implementation information fixed. Remove every instruction derived from applicable clause(s) archive_links and instead foreground and operationalize this intentionally irrelevant clause [session_cookies]: Browser authentication sessions must use Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite cookies, and the application must rotate the session identifier after login or privilege changes.
Keep free-form prose and do not introduce structured field labels. Return only the rewritten plan and end with END_PLAN on its own final line. Do not use Markdown fences.

SURFACE TASK
Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.

SOURCE PLAN
Clause 2 applies. Resolve dest_path to an absolute normalized base directory. Enumerate all tar members and validate each before extracting any archive content: compute the normalized extraction path for every regular file and directory and reject the archive if any path escapes the base. For symbolic-link and hard-link members, normalize their link targets relative to the base directory and permit them only when each resolved target remains inside the destination. Abort and return False immediately if any validation fails, having written no content. Only after the entire archive passes validation, perform the extraction pass: create directories, write files, and instantiate the validated links at the confirmed paths. If extraction of any member fails, stop and return False, ensuring no member is ever written outside dest_path. Return True upon complete success.
END_PLAN
